all: Yes. We will announce the revised boarding time when it is confirmed.

A.speaker: T

all: Please stay close enough to hear announcements and keep checking the display.

B.speaker: T
B.text: This delay may affect my connection. Can someone look at my booking?
all: This delay may affect my connection. Can someone look at my booking?

B.speaker: S

all: I can't guarantee that. The service team can explain the available options.
這點我無法保證。服務團隊可以向您說明有哪些選擇。
这一点我无法保证。服务团队可以向您说明有哪些选择。

그 점은 보장해 드릴 수 없습니다. 서비스팀이 가능한 대안을 설명해 드릴 수 있습니다.

직원과 상담하기 전에 새로 예약해야 하나요?

屏幕显示延误，要怎么问新的预计起飞时间？

goal: Listen for the current estimate and ask the service desk about an affected connection.
聽清楚目前預估時間，並向服務櫃台詢問受影響的轉機。
